summary: Round 2 testing of the Tredye-style visuals and the theme toggle (market closed, data from the 02-Nov-2026 session). Backend: 27/27 pytest pass. That is the 19 from iteration 1 plus 8 new /api/pulse tests: keys, no NaN/Inf, headline/tape/status label, mood weights adding up to the score, rotation sign/sum consistency, NIFTY/BANKNIFTY tag/intraday/expected range, VIX spark (30), percentile, nifty_move_pts = ltp*VIX/sqrt(252), and sort order of treemap and lists. Frontend at 1920: the headline and 'Market closed · showing today's close' status label render. Tabs switch content (overview/money/order). Money rotation shows 5 inflow nodes and 1 outflow node (IT), 19 animated dots, and net flow +₹24,620 cr. The surge button (DIXON), inflow node, outflow node, treemap cell (HDFCBANK), leader and laggard buttons all open the drawer. Mood card shows 78 Risk-on and all 4 parts. NIFTY and BANKNIFTY cards show ltp, Bullish tag, chart and range. VIX card shows 15.50 Normal, 71st percentile, ±229 pts. Treemap has 200 cells. Signal summary has 4 counts and the gainers/losers/shockers lists render. Money tab: 13 sector bars with visible widths, 12 top inflow rows and 12 top outflow rows, and rows open the drawer. Order tab: buy pressure, sell pressure and volume surges each have 12 rows, and rows open the drawer. Theme toggle: light is the default, switching gives dark with html.dark and mp_theme=dark, and this survives a reload. Pulse, Signals and the drawer are readable in dark; Watchlist, News and the drawer are readable in light. Regressions all pass: Signals filters, search, watchlist star toggle (localStorage), ⌘K search opening the drawer, and the news source filter. No page errors. Mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow, but the money rotation SVG text becomes unreadable there.

minor.issue: The inflow amount is the sum of the top 5 inflow sectors, but only 3 names are listed ('₹21,456 cr went into Energy & Metals & Industrials'). Either list all 5 or sum only the 3 named. The joiner also produces 'A & B & C'; use 'A, B & C'.

Outflow sector nodes open s.top_in, the stock in that sector with the largest positive flow. For IT this opened COFORGE instead of the biggest outflow stock, INFY. Add a top_out field (the stock with min flow_cr) and use it for outflow nodes.
When the market is closed it always says 'showing today's close', which is wrong on weekends, holidays and before 09:15. Use "last session's close (<date>)" when the data date is not today.

ui_bugs.issue: The SVG (viewBox 960x360) shrinks to about 40% scale, so sector names, ₹ values and the NET FLOW text render at about 5px and cannot be read. Use a vertical or simpler layout below md, or larger fonts with a min-height.
The ordinal suffix is hard-coded, so it shows '71th percentile'. Use proper ordinals (st/nd/rd/th).
The active 'Pulse' tab label has very low contrast against its active background (it is almost invisible).

issues: The Sector Money Flow panel stretches to the height of the 12-row lists, leaving a large empty area below the 13 bars. Use self-start or add a summary.
The linear bar scale makes every sector except Energy a sliver. Consider a sqrt scale.
Stocks with positive % change (BANKBARODA +2.75%, M&M +1.80%) appear as outflows because of the CLV estimate. Add a tooltip or note saying 'estimated from close location', or users will be confused.
Most cells have no labels at 390px. Acceptable, but consider tap-to-show labels.
The CNBC feed is US-centric (Rivian, Starbucks), which does not fit an NSE dashboard.

action_items: Make MoneyRotation readable on mobile (alternate layout or larger text below md)
Fix the rotation_text inflow sum/name mismatch and the 'A & B & C' joining
Add top_out per sector and use it for the outflow node click
Fix active mobile nav tab contrast in the light theme
Make status_label say last session's close with its date when the data is not from today
critical_code_review_comments: Pulse.jsx load() swallows errors (.catch(() => {})). If the first fetch fails, the skeleton shows forever with no error state.
The Headline split on ':' depends on the 'X tape:' prefix. The tape and the rest already exist as separate data, so send headline_rest from the backend instead of string-splitting.
pulse._vix_card divides by len(hist), which throws ZeroDivisionError if hist and spark are both empty. Guard it.
The SVG <g> nodes are clickable only on painted text or circles. Add a transparent hit rect for a larger tap target, especially on mobile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<from frontend/.env> pytest /app/backend/tests -q (27 tests, about 45s). The market was closed and the data date was 02-Nov-2026, so expected.by is 03-Nov. Only 1 outflow sector (IT) appeared. SVG nodes need clicks on their text or circle child (Playwright clicking the <g> centre misses). Theme key: mp_theme.
